entities.summary: Musa Alami Arabic: موسى العلمي, Müsə al-'Alāmi) was a Palestinian nationalist politician. Due to Alami having represented Palestine at various Arab conferences, in the 1940s, he was viewed by many as the leader of the Palestinian Arabs.
